PLAN "12-Week Strength Programme - Endometriosis-Phased"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build intermediate strength while phasing around cycle and flare windows"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 1x10
          hip_circles 1x10
          goblet_squat 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1x45
          hip_flexor_stretch 1x45
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          arm_circles 1x10
          scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          chest_stretch 1x45
          tricep_stretch 1x45
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Pull + Posterior":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          arm_circles 1x10
          prone_Y 2x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          lat_stretch 1x45
          back_stretch 1x45
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Flow-Day Lower (Low Intensity)":

          walking 8m
          cat_cow 1x10
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
